response.query: What stability testing conditions (real‑time and accelerated temperatures/humidity), analytical acceptance criteria (impurity limits, marker ±% range, fingerprint similarity), and shelf‑life decision rules will we use?
response.answer: Stability testing uses real-time (25°C/60% RH) and accelerated (40°C/75% RH) conditions. Acceptance criteria include impurity limits, marker ±5% range, and fingerprint similarity. Shelf-life is determined by meeting all criteria throughout the established period.
